title: Funds traded at an exchange with weak customer checks
summary: The funds go to an exchange with weak customer checks and are traded 2 to 10 times over 1 to 3 days. They come out to a new wallet in a stablecoin or in bitcoin.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 60 cases in 100.

parties.label: the wallet that holds the funds
an exchange with weak customer checks
a new wallet that receives the funds

steps.say: The wallet sends the funds to the exchange.

basis.note: The report describes funds run through some trading at exchanges with weak checks. The wait is assumed.

steps.say: The funds are traded several times at the exchange so that they look normal.

basis.note: The report says that the trading makes the funds look normal. The count of 2 to 10 trades over 1 to 3 days and their sizes are assumed.

steps.say: The exchange sends the funds to a new wallet in a stablecoin or in bitcoin.

basis.note: No source read for this part describes a withdrawal from such an exchange to a new wallet. The report describes a transfer to bank accounts. The asset, the wait and the absence of a fee are assumed.
